description: This file contains a PHPStan rule for detecting unsafe use of regex strict group match functions within the 'composer/pcre' package. It defines a class 'UnsafeStrictGroupsCallRule' that implements the 'Rule' interface and processes static calls to certain regex matching methods, analyzing the safety of their group matches in static code analysis.

classes.name: UnsafeStrictGroupsCallRule
classes.description: A PHPStan rule class that analyzes static calls to regex functions to identify potentially unsafe usage related to group matching in regular expressions.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Returns the type of node this rule applies to, which is 'StaticCall'.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a node to check for unsafe strict group matching calls, returning analysis error messages if detected.
